name: presales-opportunity-tracker
description: Unified dev runner for API + web

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix web --no-fund --no-audit
